newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN UNIBANKA H1 NET PROFIT 3.2 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN UNIBANKA H1 NET PROFIT 3.2 MLN LATS.

text.p: The stock exchange on Tuesday said that Unibanka's first-half net profit was 3.185 million lats.
The bourse, in a statement, gave no further details on Unibanka's income for the first half of the year but said that its assets were at 187.716 million lats after six months.
Credits extended were at 62.82 million lats while deposits amounted to 133.86 million lats, including 26.09 million lats of individuals' deposits.
Unibanka's first-half profit last year was 3.6 million lats and it made a full-year 1996 profit after tax of 5.978 million lats.
Its assets at the end of 1996 were 149.735 million lats.
